notes.title: Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

We apologize for not writing anything so long, we are very busy with SEX HENTAI VR development.

At the moment, we can only say that we are working on the most realistic game ever made on VR !!!

We are very excited about what has been done and we can't wait to show you the first teaser of the game.

Thank you for being patient and see you.

SEX HENTAI VR development team
